CardPrompt.title: CardPrompt
CardPrompt.description: Prompt shown to the learner. Fields depend on the card type; unused ones are null.

PreparedCard.title: PreparedCard
PreparedCard.description: Result of `prepare`; `fallback_cards` are flashcard intros when generation failed.

SessionCard.title: SessionCard
SessionCard.description:
A card of the session.

Every card carries a `CardPrompt` in `prompt`. Production exercises put the generated text in
`prompt.text` (null until `prepare` has run) and also set `subtype`, `instructions`,
`glossary` and `item_ids`; `item_id` is their primary target.
